meta.name: Pika UI
meta.notes: v0.1.0 (Pika UI 0.1.0): WCAG 2.2 AAA pass — upgraded from AA to AAA (7:1 body text / 4.5:1 large text in both themes), changed light ground from pink (#e8b4d9) to 'manual paper' (#faf3e3) for better contrast, updated all *Strong colors for AAA compliance, enhanced focus rings (3px solid, 2px offset), verified 44×44px tap targets, full reduced-motion support (SC 2.2.2). All text pairings verified ≥7:1 in light AND dark.

display.usage: H1 only — hero title, reveal moment, primary CTA. Single weight, no bold/italic available.

subheading.usage: H2-H4, buttons, form labels, vote counters. Retro CRT-terminal feel, far more legible than the display font at UI sizes.

body.usage: Paragraphs, inputs, long-form copy. Rounded and warm, pairs with VT323, actually readable for sentences.

fontWeight.note: Press Start 2P and VT323 are single-weight fonts; weight tokens apply to Nunito (body) only.

light.background_note: Manual paper — AAA ground (brand pink #e8b4d9 is decorative-only: foreground on it is 5:1, fails AAA)
light.primary_note: Decorative only (2.9:1) — do not use for text
light.secondary_note: Decorative only (3.0:1) — do not use for text
light.accent_note: Decorative only (1.4:1) — do not use for text
light.accentForeground_note: Text ON the gold fill — 10.2:1 on gold (AAA)
light.accentText_note: Accent as standalone text on the page — 12.9:1 paper (AAA)
light.destructive_note: Decorative only (3.9:1) — do not use for text
light.switchBackground_contrast: Non-text: 4.4:1 vs white, 4.0:1 vs paper (SC 1.4.11, 3:1 minimum)

dark.accentForeground_note: Text ON the gold fill — 14.3:1 on gold (AAA)
dark.accentText_note: Accent as standalone text on dark page — 14.3:1 bg (AAA)

radius.note: All flattened to 0px for pixel-art consistency

contrast.bodyText: 7:1 minimum in both light and dark themes
contrast.largeText: 4.5:1 minimum in both light and dark themes
contrast.note: Every *Strong and *Text colour pair verified in both themes

wcagCriteria: 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured, Minimum (AA, new in 2.2)

tapTargetMinimum.appliesTo: buttons, links styled as buttons, checkboxes/radios, switches, text inputs, selects. Inline text links are exempt per spec.

reducedMotion.handling: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables pixel-float/pulse/blink and the CRT scanline overlay

effects.pixelBorder: 4px hard-edged 4-directional box-shadow, no blur, uses border color
effects.crtScanlines: repeating-linear-gradient overlay, 4px pitch, 15% black opacity, z-index 100, disabled under prefers-reduced-motion
